inbodydescription.para: CCF should not disable unused clocks since all clocks are managed by PLM and when XPm_InitFinalize() is called PLM will release all unused devices and disables its clocks. So add CLK_IGNORE_UNUSED flag for all GATE to avoid disabling unused clocks from Linux CCF driver.
